title: 634HD materials
description: Extra maps for 634 textures, keyed by texture id. The cache texture stays the albedo; maps live under 634hd/materials/<texture>/. Used with client.hd.materials. Ids from 10000 up are 634HD's own materials: their albedo file is the colour map (HdMaterialProvider), and model and tile overrides use them.

albedo.description: 634HD's own materials only (texture 10000 and up): the colour map, multiplied by the face or tile colour

orm.description: red: ambient occlusion, green: roughness, blue: emissive mask
